transcript: All the aspects that I would be looking for are already somehow included, although not all in one given vignette, but divided over those. And I would be looking for one aspect that I have not seen is how the lifestyle of one society affects the other societies existing in this whole world. That would be a systemic part that I would love to see in my vision. Also, I'd love to have both the nature aspect, the peaceful aspect, and maybe small elements of abundance as much as given within the other priorities.
